claims.statement: Denver Ed Smith followed his brother to St. Louis and also stayed at Tom Allen's place.

claims.statement: Tom Allen said he would back Denver Ed Smith if Smith could get a match with a prominent pugilist, and Smith would then probably train in St. Louis.
